data.name: approved_entry_no_edit
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER approved_entry_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE ON attendance_entries
WHEN OLD.state IN ('approved', 'linked')
  AND (NEW.clock_minutes <> OLD.clock_minutes OR NEW.break_minutes <> OLD.break_minutes
    OR (OLD.client_rate_fils IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.client_billable_minutes <> OLD.client_billable_minutes
      OR NEW.client_rate_fils IS NOT OLD.client_rate_fils OR NEW.client_amount_fils IS NOT OLD.client_amount_fils))
    OR NEW.worker_payable_minutes <> OLD.worker_payable_minutes
    OR NEW.worker_rate_fils IS NOT OLD.worker_rate_fils OR NEW.worker_amount_fils IS NOT OLD.worker_amount_fils
    OR NEW.worker_id <> OLD.worker_id OR NEW.work_date <> OLD.work_date)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'approved attendance is immutable');
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER audit_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'audit events are append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER audit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'audit events are append-only');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rooms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "trade" TEXT NULL, "joining_date" TEXT NULL, "room_charge_fils" INTEGER NULL, "room_charge_note" TEXT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id), "visa_instalment_fils" INTEGER NULL CHECK("visa_instalment_fils" > 0), "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("tenant_id", "code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "contact_person" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "vat_registered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("vat_registered" IN (0, 1)), "trn" TEXT NULL, "invoice_address" TEXT NULL, "due_days" INTEGER NULL, "po_reference" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sites" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "location" TEXT NULL, "contact" TEXT NULL, "active_from" TEXT NULL, "active_to" TEXT NULL, "default_start_minute" INTEGER NULL, "default_end_minute" INTEGER NULL, "default_break_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cash_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_fils" > 0), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "worker_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "room_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id), "client_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "site_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "category" TEXT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "note" TEXT NULL, "reverses_entry_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES cash_entries (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (kind NOT IN ('advanceGiven', 'salaryPaid', 'advanceReturned') OR worker_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (kind NOT IN ('roomRentPaid', 'roomRentReceived') OR room_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (kind <> 'clientReceipt' OR client_id IS NOT NULL));
CREATE TRIGGER cash_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON cash_entries BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'cash entries are append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER cash_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON cash_entries BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'cash entries are append-only');END

CREATE TRIGGER cash_visa_needs_worker BEFORE INSERT ON cash_entries WHEN NEW.kind IN ('visaPaid', 'visaReturned') AND NEW.worker_id IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a visa line needs a worker');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_to" TEXT NOT NULL, "posting_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER payroll_run_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON payroll_runs BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'posted payroll is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER payroll_run_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payroll_runs BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'posted payroll is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payroll_runs (id), "worker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "period_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "earned_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "salary_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "adjustment_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "allowances_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deductions_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recovery_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "visa_recovery_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "net_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payable_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_before_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reversed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reversed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER payroll_line_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE OF run_id, worker_id, period_from, opening_fils, earned_fils, salary_fils, adjustment_fils, allowances_fils, deductions_fils, recovery_fils, visa_recovery_fils, net_fils, payable_fils, paid_before_fils ON payroll_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'posted payroll is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER payroll_line_stays_reversed BEFORE UPDATE OF reversed ON payroll_lines WHEN OLD.reversed BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a reversed payroll line stays reversed');END
CREATE TRIGGER payroll_line_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payroll_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'posted payroll is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "worker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "period_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_fils" > 0), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "authorized_by" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id), "line_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payroll_lines (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (kind NOT IN ('deduction', 'roomCharge') OR authorized_by IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TRIGGER posted_item_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE OF worker_id, period_from, kind, amount_fils, reason, authorized_by, room_id ON payroll_items WHEN OLD.line_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a posted payroll item is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER posted_item_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payroll_items WHEN OLD.line_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a posted payroll item is immutable');END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_live_payroll_line ON payroll_lines (worker_id, period_from) WHERE NOT reversed

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "worker_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "site_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "daily_rate_fils" INTEGER NULL CHECK("daily_rate_fils" >= 0), "half_day_is_half" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("half_day_is_half" IN (0, 1)), "start_minute" INTEGER NULL, "end_minute" INTEGER NULL, "break_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "work_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "group_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES worker_groups (id), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attendance_batches (id), "worker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "group_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES worker_groups (id), "work_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_utc" INTEGER NULL, "end_utc" INTEGER NULL, "clock_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("clock_minutes" >= 0), "break_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("break_minutes" >= 0), "break_paid_client" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("break_paid_client" IN (0, 1)), "break_paid_worker" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("break_paid_worker" IN (0, 1)), "client_billable_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "worker_payable_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "overtime_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "overtime_approved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("overtime_approved" IN (0, 1)), "attendance_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "client_ack" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "client_basis" TEXT NULL, "client_rate_fils" INTEGER NULL, "client_amount_fils" INTEGER NULL, "worker_basis" TEXT NULL, "worker_rate_fils" INTEGER NULL, "worker_amount_fils" INTEGER NULL, "client_rate_override_fils" INTEGER NULL, "worker_rate_override_fils" INTEGER NULL, "override_reason" TEXT NULL, "overlap_reason" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "revises_entry_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES attendance_entries (id), "superseded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("superseded" IN (0, 1)), "payroll_line_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payroll_lines (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (break_minutes <= clock_minutes));

CREATE TRIGGER approved_entry_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE ON attendance_entries WHEN OLD.state IN ('approved', 'linked') AND(NEW.clock_minutes <> OLD.clock_minutes OR NEW.break_minutes <> OLD.break_minutes OR(OLD.client_rate_fils IS NOT NULL AND(NEW.client_billable_minutes <> OLD.client_billable_minutes OR NEW.client_rate_fils IS NOT OLD.client_rate_fils OR NEW.client_amount_fils IS NOT OLD.client_amount_fils))OR NEW.worker_payable_minutes <> OLD.worker_payable_minutes OR NEW.worker_rate_fils IS NOT OLD.worker_rate_fils OR NEW.worker_amount_fils IS NOT OLD.worker_amount_fils OR NEW.worker_id <> OLD.worker_id OR NEW.work_date <> OLD.work_date)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'approved attendance is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER linked_entry_keeps_state BEFORE UPDATE ON attendance_entries WHEN OLD.state = 'linked' AND NEW.state <> 'linked' BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'linked attendance is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER entry_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON attendance_entries WHEN OLD.state NOT IN ('draft', 'submitted') BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'approved attendance cannot be deleted');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tenant_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "legal_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "trading_name" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "vat_registered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("vat_registered" IN (0, 1)), "vat_effective_from" TEXT NULL, "trn" TEXT NULL, "invoice_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INV', "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "payment_terms_days" INTEGER NULL, "bank_details" TEXT NULL, "document_footer" TEXT NULL, "deduction_limit_bps" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pay_contracts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "basis" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("rate_fils" >= 0), "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_to" TEXT NULL, "break_paid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("break_paid" IN (0, 1)), "half_amount_fils" INTEGER NULL, "included_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "overtime_rate_fils" INTEGER NULL, "worker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "site_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "partial_method" TEXT NULL, "partial_divisor" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "billing_contracts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "basis" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("rate_fils" >= 0), "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_to" TEXT NULL, "break_paid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("break_paid" IN (0, 1)), "half_amount_fils" INTEGER NULL, "included_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "overtime_rate_fils" INTEGER NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "site_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "worker_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "opening_balances" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "worker_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "client_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "amount_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_fils" >= 0), "as_of_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_note" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("kind", "worker_id"), UNIQUE ("kind", "client_id"), CHECK ((worker_id IS NULL) <> (client_id IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "worker_group_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worker_groups (id), "worker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "daily_rate_fils" INTEGER NULL CHECK("daily_rate_fils" >= 0), "rate_basis" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'day', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("group_id", "worker_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "acked_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("operation_id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_cash_date ON cash_entries (entry_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_cash_worker ON cash_entries (worker_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_cash_room ON cash_entries (room_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_entries_worker_date ON attendance_entries (worker_id, work_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_entries_date ON attendance_entries (work_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_payroll_lines_worker ON payroll_lines (worker_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_payroll_items_period ON payroll_items (period_from)
